description: This file defines the RetrieveAttributeResponse class, which models the response to a retrieve attribute command in a Ditto-based IoT framework. It includes methods for constructing instances from JSON, accessing attribute data, and serializing the response.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a retrieve attribute command, encapsulating the attribute value, associated thing ID, and JSON pointer.

methods.name: RetrieveAttributeResponse.of
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveAttributeResponse with specified thing ID, attribute pointer, attribute value, and headers.

methods.name: RetrieveAttributeResponse.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveAttributeResponse object from a JSON string or JSON object, including deserialization logic.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing entity related to this response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the attribute value according to the specified schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified entity replacing the current attribute value.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path of the attribute.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into a JSON object builder, conditioned on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object can be considered equal to this instance.
